signals.name: H1: VIX stress amplifies the oil ripple
signals.mechanism: Geopolitical shocks ripple harder into oil when market stress (VIX) is already elevated
signals.method: conditioned event study + Jorda local projection
signals.oos_metric: walk-forward realized amplification (ON minus OFF), pp
signals.evidence: amp 4.9823pp, 95%CI [0.6469, 8.592], FDR q=0.0129, survives_bonferroni=True; walk-forward OOS +4.0pp

signals.name: H2: tight inventories amplify
signals.mechanism: Tight physical inventories amplify the ripple
signals.evidence: amp -0.5182pp, 95%CI [-4.6598, 3.3947], CI excludes 0=False (was small-sample noise at n=20)

signals.name: H3: crowded positioning amplifies
signals.mechanism: Crowded net-long positioning amplifies the ripple
signals.evidence: amp -4.6891pp, 95%CI [-9.2519, 0.3656], CI excludes 0=False (was small-sample noise at n=20)

signals.name: Analogue turbulence forecaster
signals.mechanism: Share of prior analogues whose oil pattern was non-clean predicts turbulence
signals.method: kNN over analogue library + LOO isotonic
signals.evidence: Brier 0.3993 vs base 0.2494; CPCV skill -0.1424, PBO 0.0, DM p=0.0002 -> null

signals.name: kNN state-signature probability
signals.mechanism: States resembling prior large-ripple episodes predict an above-median ripple
signals.evidence: clustered Brier 0.2123 vs 0.2394, PBO 0.443, DM p=0.1104 -> null (all-events 'skill' was a clustering artifact)

signals.name: Realized Brent vol -> ripple magnitude (candidate)
signals.mechanism: Elevated pre-event realized oil volatility precedes larger ripples
signals.evidence: survives 4 gates (r=0.41, partial_r=0.379) BUT likely volatility clustering -- needs the standardization defeater before promotion

signals.name: Kalman nowcast: eia.crude_stocks_xspr
signals.mechanism: Local-level Kalman tracks the latent level of a lagged weekly state var
signals.evidence: 68% coverage 0.744 (in band True), beats persistence False
